tools.name: bedrijfsrooster_get_configuration
tools.description: Get the company this access token belongs to: its id and name, its group, and its locations, departments, functions and shift types. Call this first. The ids it returns are the filters for the other tools. Bedrijfsrooster API: GET /configuration.

tools.name: bedrijfsrooster_list_users
tools.description: List the employees (CompanyUsers) with an active or future employment in the company, optionally within a period. Set extendedDetails only when the user asks for personal details: it adds birthday, email and address. Bedrijfsrooster API: GET /users.

tools.name: bedrijfsrooster_list_contracts
tools.description: List the contracts between the company and its employees that are active at the snapshot date or within a period. Bedrijfsrooster API: GET /contracts.

tools.name: bedrijfsrooster_list_timetable
tools.description: List the shifts of the company timetable: scheduled work shifts, availability, relief (vacation, days off) and non-attendance (sick days, no-shows). Choose which kinds to include with the shifts* flags. The reply is paged: use pageIndex (from 1) and itemsPerPage (1 to 1000), or disablePaging for a s

tools.name: bedrijfsrooster_get_report
tools.description: Get the stored result of one finished Bedrijfsrooster report by its reportId, for example the relief hours balance. A report that is still running returns HTTP 409 with its percentage_complete: call again later. Needs the company:reports:read integration permission. Bedrijfsrooster API: GET /reports

tools.name: bedrijfsrooster_get_availability
tools.description: Get the availability (beschikbaarheid) per date, for each employee (companyUser) or each function (companyFunction). Use periodStart and periodEnd together, within one month (up to 31 days). Needs the company:availability:read integration permission. Bedrijfsrooster API: GET /availability.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: bedrijfsrooster_list_users · Private data: bedrijfsrooster_get_configuration · Public sink: bedrijfsrooster_list_users.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: bedrijfsrooster_list_users · Private data: bedrijfsrooster_get_configuration · Public sink: bedrijfsrooster_list_users

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
